entry_state: Lease tax and Apple's tax disclosures separate expense, balances, restricted funds and settlement. The Northstar forecast retains one shared unknown across statements. Awards and capitalisation need their own measurement facts. Subsequent returns reconcile debit-positive journals, while impairment reversals retain an unresolved case when every eligible allocation weight is zero.
exit_state: Subsequent lease reductions preserve actual surrendered rights; contract-cost impairment precedes measurement of a remaining onerous duty. Tax benefits retain their acquisition, profit or OCI origin. Rule selection now separates operative authority, historical support and adoption dates. ASBE lease and tax adoption follow different clocks; the tax-transition explanation continues.
findings: The heterogeneous-rights lease example requires attributed amounts, not one physical percentage.
The onerous-contract example distinguishes loss of the existing asset from the remaining obligation, and shows that the minimum unavoidable loss does not choose management's action.
Tax origins and gross balances survive allocation and offset presentation. Current authority remains distinct from inspected historical amendments.
ASBE lease adoption dates depend on enterprise group and elections; Interpretation16 has its own application period. No new confirmed defect.
